<thought>Based on the high‑intensity peak at m/z 193.1103 (likely the [M+H]⁺ ion), the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈192.103 Da. The isotopic pattern shows a ~12 % M+1 peak, indicating about 10–11 carbons. A formula that matches the mass and carbon count is C₁₁H₁₂O₃ (exact monoisotopic mass 192.0786 Da, within typical high‑resolution error and consistent with the observed isotopic intensity). No other heteroatoms are required, so the formula fits the required CxHyOzX format without an extra element.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H12O3</final_answer>
